notes.title: Maxwell's puzzling demon v1.5.14
notes.content:
Levels update

Slightly changed 2-14, 2-20? and w5?₂₅.
Changed [spoiler]w0[/spoiler] to clearly indicate that [spoiler]pushing the outer wall[/spoiler] does not lead to completing the level.

Other changes

Corrected some text.

Announcement
It's the first anniversary of Maxwell's Puzzling Demon! it also achieved (approximately) 10,000 downloads and I'm really glad such many have enjoyed this game!
I've thoroughly enjoyed seeing all your reviews, videos, and streams. Improvements like suppressing unintended solutions and refining hint levels were only possible thanks to your feedbacks. Thank you so much!
While I still have several things I'd like to add in future updates—like [spoiler]fixing the piston bug, releasing the level editor[/spoiler], and adding some extra worlds, I've currently been prioritizing my next puzzle game.
You can expect more detailed annouce with in this year!

notes.content:
Extra contents
New levels await you at the far right of w0. They are very challenging, but I hope you enjoy them.

Levels update

  Added [spoiler]A-36[/spoiler] and [spoiler]A-37[/spoiler].
  Adjusted 2-3?, 2-7?, 2-14?, 4-8, 5-7?, 5-11?, 7-A, 7-H and [spoiler]0-26?[/spoiler].

      (1) After clearing 2-1, you can see [spoiler]what level blocks are like before and after they are solved[/spoiler].
      (2) The display of [spoiler]the contents of pistons[/spoiler] unlocked by reaching 6-7 is now compatible with [spoiler]multiple nested pistons[/spoiler] (w8 spoiler).
  You can switch the save slot from the setting.
